name: 29302 · Spartanburg, SC
findings: ZIP 29302 (Spartanburg) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29302 (Spartanburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29302 (Spartanburg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
